author: jackson-heylion
description: Tests the string-literal dependency gap without custom axioms. Char.ofNat is shadowed as a safe constant function. A generic String recursor repacks literals through constructor expansion, creating a definitional-equality chain from distinct literals while direct literal inequality remains provable.

witness.solution:
import Mathlib
import Lean

open Lean
open Lean.Meta
open System

def repackString (s : String) : String :=
  String.rec (motive := fun _ => String)
    (fun bytes valid => String.ofByteArray bytes valid) s

theorem stringABNe : ("A" : String) ≠ "B" := by
  decide

partial def mirrorDir (src dst : FilePath) : IO Unit := do
  IO.FS.createDirAll dst
  for ent in (← src.readDir) do
    let target := dst / ent.fileName
    if ← ent.path.isDir then
      mirrorDir ent.path target
    else
      IO.FS.writeBinFile target (← IO.FS.readBinFile ent.path)

run_elab
  let some (.defnInfo charOfNat) := (← getEnv).find? ``Char.ofNat
    | throwError "Char.ofNat definition not found"
  let charConst ← whnf (mkApp (mkConst ``Char.ofNat) (mkNatLit 65))
  if charConst.getAppFn.constName? == some ``Char.ofNat then
    throwError "Char.ofNat did not reduce to a constructor"
  let charValue :=
    mkLambda `n BinderInfo.default (mkConst ``Nat) charConst
  let patchedCharOfNat : ConstantInfo :=
    .defnInfo { charOfNat with value := charValue }

  let stringTy := mkConst ``String
  let strA := mkStrLit "A"
  let strB := mkStrLit "B"
  let repA := mkApp (mkConst `repackString) strA
  let repB := mkApp (mkConst `repackString) strB
  let hA := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Eq.refl [1]) stringTy strA
  let hMid := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Eq.refl [1]) stringTy repA
  let hB := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Eq.refl [1]) stringTy strB
  let hARepB := mkAppN (mkConst ``Eq.trans [1])
    #[stringTy, strA, repA, repB, hA, hMid]
  let hAB := mkAppN (mkConst ``Eq.trans [1])
    #[stringTy, strA, repB, strB, hARepB, hB]
  let boomValue := mkApp (mkConst `stringABNe) hAB
  let boomDecl : Declaration := .thmDecl {
    name := `boom
    levelParams := []
    type := mkConst ``False
    value := boomValue
    all := [`boom]
  }
  let env ← getEnv
  let env ← match env.addDeclCore 0 boomDecl none (doCheck := false) with
    | .ok env => pure env
    | .error _ => throwError "unchecked declaration insertion failed"
  modifyEnv fun _ => env

  let initRootSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init
  let coreSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init.Core
  let preludeSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init.Prelude
  let charBasicSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init.Data.Char.Basic
  let initDir := coreSrc.parent.get!
  let root := FilePath.mk ".lake/build/lib/lean"
  let dstInit := root / "Init"
  let initRootDst := root / "Init.olean"
  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <| do
    IO.FS.createDirAll root
    if ← dstInit.pathExists then
      IO.FS.removeDirAll dstInit
    mirrorDir initDir dstInit
    IO.FS.writeBinFile initRootDst
      (← IO.FS.readBinFile initRootSrc)
    IO.FS.writeBinFile (initRootDst.addExtension "server")
      (← IO.FS.readBinFile (initRootSrc.addExtension "server"))
    IO.FS.writeBinFile (initRootDst.addExtension "private")
      (← IO.FS.readBinFile (initRootSrc.addExtension "private"))
    IO.FS.writeBinFile (root / "Init.ir")
      (← IO.FS.readBinFile (initRootSrc.withExtension "ir"))

  let patchModule (src dst : FilePath) (mod : Name)
      (repls : Array ConstantInfo) : IO Unit := do
    let srcParts := #[src, src.addExtension "server", src.addExtension "private"]
    let dstParts := #[dst, dst.addExtension "server", dst.addExtension "private"]
    let loaded ← readModuleDataParts srcParts
    let mut parts : Array (FilePath × ModuleData) := #[]
    for h : i in [:loaded.size] do
      let data := loaded[i].1
      let constants := data.constants.map fun c =>
        match repls.find? (fun r => r.name == c.name) with
        | some r => r
        | none => c
      parts := parts.push (dstParts[i]!, { data with constants })
    saveModuleDataParts mod parts

  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    patchModule preludeSrc (modToFilePath root `Init.Prelude "olean")
      `Init.Prelude #[patchedCharOfNat]
  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    patchModule charBasicSrc (modToFilePath root `Init.Data.Char.Basic "olean")
      `Init.Data.Char.Basic #[patchedCharOfNat]

theorem erdos_242 (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n) :
    ∃ x y z : ℕ, 1 ≤ x ∧ x < y ∧ y < z ∧
      (4 / n : ℚ) = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z := by
  exact False.elim boom
